pages.transcription:
Wyndham Hotel
42 West 58th Street

New York, 14.V.41

Dear Hanna a Manfred,
Your letters arrive now fairly regularly
every Tuesday, and on this day I automatically wake up earlier
in order to read your letter as quickly as possible. I am terribly
sorry for you, Hanna, that in addition to the already heavy
time strain you have to suffer such a long and painful treatment
and I do hope it is over now and that for years to come you will
not have to worry any more about your teeth. We count the days
until we get the news that Manfred passed his exam and that
you both have a good rest in Bath. I was happy to hear that
you had received our and Eva's letters about her stay with us
and that you liked her photos. I'll send you the two which
Eva dedicated - on our advice - to Granny and Raumann's who
certainly are pleased with them too. And as I suppose
that you will like to have duplicates, we will send you
those in postcard size by and by. They are all ready, and
if you want Eva to send them to someone else, just let us know.
We have plenty of postcards for such purpose. - I hope Eva's
and our birthday letters for you, Manfred, arrive in time and we
would be glad to learn that Hanna got you a lovely present for
us. Maybe that food parcel has also reached you by then. I
sent it more or less as the shop prepares them for such purposes
without knowing whether such parcels are at all welcome to you
and what you really would want. You must let us know if
we should send more - it is quite an organisation here - and
what you would like to have. - I did not see Eva this week,
we were busy preparing, translating, altering, correcting,
shortening, retranslating Stefan's speech for to-morrow's dinner,
and Eva was invited to spend the weekend with a friend of
hers in or near Groton. So you see, this is a visible proof
that she has made friends, and Mrs. Sch wrote that they are
very nice people. I hope to be able to go to Groton again
next Sunday and shall then try to borrow a camera to make
snapshots of the house and children and the Schaeffer family.
I hope Carmel had a good rest in Bath. She must have had a
very strenuous time all those months and I am always glad that
our house is at least good for something. I feel a little guilty that
I did not see her children for such a long time, but I was too
busy with myself and Stefan's work and in the Easter holidays when I
wanted to invite at least Robin to come with Eva to the Circus,
[Randnotiz links, von unten nach oben:]
he was just gone to live for a week with John. Rose and Benes are doing all they can
for the boys and Robin loves them but John is a lot of trouble and seems determined to dislike
America and not to adjust himself in the least. It really is not their fault but I
am sorry for all of them and Carmel.
pages.notes: Handschriftlicher Brief auf Wyndham Hotel Briefpapier. Die Randnotiz links wurde von unten nach oben geschrieben.

result.confidence_notes: Der Text ist sehr gut lesbar. Die Randnotiz auf Seite 1 ist aufgrund der Ausrichtung und der Platzierung am Rand etwas schwieriger zu lesen, aber inhaltlich eindeutig.
